WITH s AS (
 SELECT p.sku, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.net_amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key)
 WHERE st.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')
SELECT sku, sum(quantity) all_units, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity END) nonstaff, sum(net_amount) net, count(*) n
FROM s GROUP BY sku ORDER BY all_units DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT r.business_date, r.receipts, r.units_sold, r.net_sales_before_returns, r.returns_net, r.net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-06' ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.sale_date, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) rc, sum(quantity) u, sum(net_amount) n, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) su FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE st.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-06' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (
 SELECT p.sku, sum(f.quantity) units FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key)
 WHERE st.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
 SELECT p.sku, sum(x.quantity_returned) ret FROM fact_return_line x JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key)
 WHERE st.store_id=102 AND x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1),
nm AS (SELECT sku, max(product_name) FILTER (WHERE is_current) name, count(*) versions, max(category) cat, max(delisted_on) dl FROM dim_product GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.sku, nm.name, nm.versions, nm.cat, nm.dl, s.units, coalesce(r.ret,0) ret FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING(sku) LEFT JOIN nm USING(sku) ORDER BY s.units DESC LIMIT 8

WITH s AS (
 SELECT p.sku, sum(f.quantity) units FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key)
 WHERE st.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
 SELECT p.sku, sum(x.quantity_returned) ret FROM fact_return_line x JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key)
 WHERE st.store_id=102 AND x.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.sku, s.units, coalesce(r.ret,0) ret, s.units-coalesce(r.ret,0) net_units FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING(sku) ORDER BY s.units DESC LIMIT 8
